summary: The underlying index measures the performance of equity securities issued by U.S. and non-U.S. companies involved in breakthrough innovations and new technologies that seek to address or combat climate change, as determined by Morningstar or its affiliates. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
